svg.title: How TimelineXray is built
svg.desc: Four tiers. Source: the public upstream repository is fetched only from an allowlisted URL into a local snapshot store of pinned commits. Evidence: a manifest of every path, an exact span reader and a code index with parameters. Knowledge: a hash-chained findings ledger and classified diffs and digests. Access: the txray command line and a read-only MCP server.
